name: Rosemary Roasted Beef Tenderloin / Beef Wellington
whyItWorks: Center-cut beef tenderloin and flaky puff pastry (on Groot Remix night) offer ultra-tender protein with minimal connective tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare to medium with smooth mashed potatoes or white rice. On Beef Wellington night, scrape off the mushroom duxelles layer if mushrooms bother your gut.
watchOuts: Finely chopped mushroom duxelles inside Beef Wellington
Coarse rosemary needles on the crust
